The function $\Delta$ is continuously differentiable on $(0,1)$, with \begin{equation} \Delta'(z)=\frac{\mu'(z)}3\big(\rho(z)^3-s_{\mu(z)/3}^3\big). \end{equation} If $\Delta(z)=0$, then $\rho(z)<s_{\mu(z)/3}$. Moreover, $\Delta(z)\to-\frac12$ as $z\to0$, and $\Delta(10^{-3})>0$.

changes.new_statement: Let $\Phi:\R^3\to\R$ be three times continuously differentiable, $P\in\R^3$, $\delta>0$ and $\mathcal C_\delta=\{q\in\R^3:|q-P|_\infty\le\delta\}$. Assume that $\Phi(P)=0$ and $\nabla\Phi(P)=0$. Assume also that $\nabla^2\Phi(P)-\lambda_0I$ is positive semidefinite for some $\lambda_0>0$, and that \[ S_3\ge\sum_{i,j,k=1}^3\max_{q\in \mathcal C_\delta}|\partial_i\partial_j\partial_k\Phi(q)|,\quad \delta S_3<3\lambda_0 . \] Then for every $y\in\R^3$ with $0<|y|_\infty\le\delta$, \[ \Phi(P+y)\ge\frac{\lambda_0}2|y|_2^2-\frac{S_3}6|y|_\infty^3 \ge\Big(\frac{\lambda_0}2-\frac{\delta S_3}6\Big)|y|_\infty^2>0 . \]

Let $n^{-1/2}\ll p\ll1$, $\eta\in(0,1)$ and $r=\eta^{1/3}$. \begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*)] \item $\mathrm{LT}_{n,p}(\eta)=(1+o(1))\frac{n^2p}2V(r)$. \item Let $\varepsilon>0$. Conditionally on $T_n\le\eta\E[T_n]$, with probability $1-o(1)$ there is a minimizer $W$ at $r$ with $\delta_\cut(p^{-1}W_A,W)\le\varepsilon$. \end{enumerate}

Let $M$ be a real symmetric $n\times n$ matrix, $0\le a<b\le1$ and $\delta>0$. Suppose that there are a measure preserving $\varphi$ and a measurable $S_0\subset[0,1]$ with $|S_0|=\frac12$ such that $\|W_M^\varphi-B^{S_0}_{a,b}\|_\cut\le\delta$. Then there is $S\subset[n]$ with $\big||S|-\frac n2\big|\le\frac{16\delta n}{b-a}$ and $\|M-M^S_{a,b}\|_\cut\le33\delta$.

Let $n^{-1/2}\ll p\ll1$, $\eta\in(0,1)$ and $r=\eta^{1/3}$. Then \[ \mathrm{LT}_{n,p}(\eta)=(1+o(1))\frac{n^2p}2\times \begin{cases} h(r) & \text{if }\eta\ge\eta_*,\\ \Vbal(r) & \text{if }\eta<\eta_*, \end{cases} \] where $\eta_*=0.009217\ldots$.

Let $n^{-1/2}\ll p\ll1$, $\eta\in(0,1)$, $r=\eta^{1/3}$ and $\varepsilon>0$. Conditionally on $T_n\le\eta\E[T_n]$, the following holds with probability $1-o(1)$. \begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*)] \item If $\eta>\eta_*$, then $\|A-rp\1\1^{\top}\|_\cut\le\varepsilon p$. \item If $\eta<\eta_*$, then there is $S\subset[n]$ with $\big||S|-\frac n2\big|\le\varepsilon n$ and $\|A-pM^S_{a_r,b_r}\|_\cut\le\varepsilon p$. \item If $\eta=\eta_*$, then the conclusion of (a) or the conclusion of (b) holds. \end{enumerate}

Let $n\ge2$, $W\subset\R^2$ a convex polygon with vertices $w_0,\dots,w_n$ in counterclockwise order, and $A\in W$. If $(w_0)_2>A_2$ and $(w_n)_2>A_2$, then every $p\in W$ with $p_2\le A_2$ lies in $\bigcup_{j=0}^{n-1}\mathrm{conv}\{A,w_j,w_{j+1}\}$.
